section.title: Key Features and Behavior
section.description: - Create one 4.x entry for every Feature listed in Section 2.2. - Keep each Feature at user-behavior resolution. - State product values and rules precisely when changing them would change the product.

template.title: Feature Template
template.header: Feature ID: Fx | Feature name: user-oriented name from Section 2.2

subsection.title: User Goal
subsection.description: State which core ideal use case intent this Feature serves and what the confirmed Primary Persona wants to achieve.

subsection.title: Starting Conditions
subsection.description: State when the Feature is available and what confirmed information or state must already exist.

subsection.title: User Flow and Product Response
subsection.description: Describe the user actions in order and what the product visibly does after each action.

subsection.title: Required Information and Product Rules
subsection.description: - State mandatory inputs and choices. - State limits, permissions, visibility, ordering, uniqueness, allowed values, and forbidden changes. - Include exact values and units only when the user provided or approved them.

subsection.title: States and Exceptions
subsection.description: Optional. Describe only states or exceptions that the PoC must show or validate. Leave nonessential edge cases for later product or implementation work.

subsection.title: Completion Checkpoint
subsection.description: State one observable result that shows this Feature completed its role in the related core ideal use case.
